interests.title: AI Safety and Security
interests.description: Studying how to audit and align multimodal models and AI agents against evolving safety threats.

interests.title: Multimodal Large Language Models
interests.description: Investigating how MLLMs perceive, associate, and reason across modalities — and where they fall short.

interests.title: To be explored...
interests.description: Always open to new problems, discussions, and potential collaborations.

experiences.title: SafoLab, Johns Hopkins University
experiences.summary: Working on AI safety and security for vision-language models and AI agents.
bullets: First-author work on PRISM, a reasoning-based safety alignment framework for VLMs (arXiv 2025).
Contributed to DynAuditClaw, a dynamic auditing framework for Openclaw (2026).

experiences.title: XuanWu Lab, Tencent
experiences.summary: Research on the safety and security of large language models.

experiences.title: RHOS Lab (MVIG), Shanghai Jiao Tong University
experiences.summary: Benchmarked the associative capabilities of multi-modal LLMs, leading to an ICLR 2025 paper.
bullets: Co-authored The Labyrinth of Links (ICLR 2025): an association benchmark with an annotation-free construction pipeline.

interests.title: AI 安全与模型安全
interests.description: 研究如何对多模态模型与智能体进行审计与对齐，以应对不断演进的安全威胁。

interests.title: 多模态大语言模型
interests.description: 探究多模态大模型如何跨模态感知、联想与推理，以及它们的能力边界。

interests.title: 待探索...
interests.description: 始终欢迎新问题、新讨论与潜在的合作。

参与 DynAuditClaw：面向 Openclaw 的动态审计框架（2026）。
